title: When History Changes the Agent: A causal protocol for developmental continuity, appraisal, and prospective self-knowledge
description: A prospective methods preprint proposing an integrated causal protocol for record retention, developmental history dependence, revisable appraisal, useful prospective self-knowledge and recurrent integration in persistent artificial agents. Includes elementary analytical counterexamples and reproducible standard-library checks. Reports no new subject experiments. Not peer reviewed. Commissioned by David Dominik Wilson; developed with disclosed OpenAI Codex assistance.
